1.explanation: This minimal React example uses Grommet’s DataChart with type 'bar'. The `data` array includes a negative value on 2022-07-02. According to the bug report, once a negative datum is present, no bars are rendered (the chart is blank). We specify an explicit zero line with `guide={{ y: { zero: true } }}` and axes, but the bars still do not appear when negative data is in the set. This reproduces the described issue in Grommet v2.4.0 on any modern browser.
1.bug_scenario: A Grommet DataChart configured to render a bar chart hides completely when its dataset contains any negative values. Even though the positive values should produce visible bars above the zero baseline, and negative values should appear below the baseline (or at least a zero line guide), nothing is drawn at all once a negative datum is present.
